Topology.title: Government Secure Network
Topology.Description: Connect main data center to regional and branch offices with secure internet and remote access.
Topology.Summary: The topology includes a main data center, a regional office, and a branch office connected via a dedicated WAN. It features a secure internet perimeter with email and web filtering, and remote access capabilities.

Control.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
Control.Evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Management System' (n28) that manages various nodes across different zones, indicating an established and maintained asset inventory.

Control.title: Document Data Flows
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation System' (n29) that documents data flows to various nodes, indicating documented data flows.

Control.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
Control.Evidence: The topology includes multiple zones (e.g., Main Data Center, DMZ, Non-Production Zone) that are segmented, indicating data processing and storage are segmented based on sensitivity.

Control.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Firewall' (n3) in the Main Data Center, indicating firewalls are implemented and managed.

Control.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n19) and a 'DNS Filter' (n20) in the Main Data Center, indicating trusted DNS servers are configured.

Control.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Central AAA Server' (n18) and a 'Remote Access Router' (n15) with a link to the AAA server, indicating MFA is required for remote network access.

Control.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filter' (n20) and links to the 'Internet Router' (n14) and 'DNS Server' (n19), indicating DNS filtering services are used.

Control.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Web Filter' (n11) and a 'Web Proxy' (n21) with links to the 'Internet Router' (n14), indicating network-based URL filters are enforced.

Control.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
Control.Evidence: The topology includes multiple zones (e.g., Main Data Center, DMZ, Non-Production Zone) and links between them, indicating a secure network architecture is established and maintained.

Control.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Central AAA Server' (n18) and a 'SIEM' (n23) with links to various network devices, indicating secure management of network infrastructure.

Control.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Central AAA Server' (n18) with links to various network devices, indicating centralized network AAA.

Control.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'VPN Gateway' (n13) and a 'Remote Access Router' (n15) with links to the 'Central AAA Server' (n18), indicating remote devices utilize a VPN and connect to the enterprise’s AAA infrastructure.

Control.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'NIDS' (n22) in the Main Data Center with links to the 'Firewall' (n3) and 'SIEM' (n23), indicating a network intrusion detection solution is deployed.

Control.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Firewall' (n3) and links between different zones (e.g., Main Data Center to DMZ, Main Data Center to Regional Office), indicating traffic filtering between network segments.

Control.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'NAC' (n24) and links to the 'SIEM' (n23), indicating access control for remote assets is managed.

Control.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'SIEM' (n23) with links to various network devices, indicating network traffic flow logs are collected.

Control.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Non-Production Zone' (z8) with its own router (n26) and switch (n27), indicating production and non-production systems are separated.

Control.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
Control.Evidence: The topology includes a 'Penetration Testing Tool' (n30) with links to various network devices, indicating periodic external penetration tests are performed.
